name: Supabase
use_case: Build customer accounts with relational application data
audience: Small SaaS builders prepared to design access policies
verdict: A researched starting choice when Postgres, authentication and storage belong together.
tradeoff: You still own row-level security, backups and usage controls. .NET tracing excludes Realtime and needs an exporter; this does not establish end-to-end production observability.
privacy: Test isolation with two separate accounts; do not place service-role credentials in browser code. Review hosting region and retention requirements.
pricing: Checked 2026-10-19: Free $0/month, 500 MB database, 2 active projects, paused after one week of inactivity. Pro from $25/month; additional projects from $10/month and usage overages apply. Telemetry exporter costs are separate.
news: October 14: Supabase .NET SDK adds traces and metrics for Auth, Postgrest, Storage and Functions via System.Diagnostics. Realtime is not instrumented. Workflow: instrument a staging account-signup flow, collect spans in your own exporter, then inspect slow database requests. Vendor-documented, not hands-on tested.

name: Claude Code
use_case: Make a bounded repository change while tracking coding-agent usage
audience: Terminal-oriented builders who can review diffs and run project tests
verdict: A researched candidate for a scoped edit/test/review loop. Use /usage to inspect consumption; do not confuse an API cost estimate with a subscription invoice.
tradeoff: v2.1.303 release notes only say bug fixes and reliability improvements; no specific performance gain established. Costs depend on model, context and automation. Not compared on the same brief against other agents.
privacy: Review repository and tool permissions, exclude secrets, and inspect provider data terms before sending private source. Human review remains necessary.
pricing: Checked 2026-10-19 in official costs docs: API use is token-billed; Pro/Max subscribers have included usage subject to plan limits. /usage session dollars estimate API list-price consumption, not subscription billing. No fixed subscription price verified in this run; consult linked plan pricing before buying.
news: v2.1.303 published October 18 with downloadable assets; notes report only bug fixes and reliability improvements. Newly admitted to this catalog after costs documentation became readable. Workflow: scope one repository fix, review the diff, run existing tests, then inspect /usage. No vendor execution performed.
